a.xlink:title: Cancels the request. finished() is emitted if it was not emitted yet.
An event with a new random ID. occurredAt is taken as given.
True while this object holds owner.lock and no storage operation has failed.
Removes the events of both categories.
Stores a diagnostic event under its generation, as enqueueUsage() does.
The HTTP status code of the response, or 0 when no response arrived.
Releases owner.lock and drops the events held in memory. The files stay.
True for a lowercase random UUIDv4 with the RFC variant bits.
True when endpoint is on the list of retired endpoints.
The request ended, whether it succeeded, failed or was cancelled. Emitted once.
Returns the bytes received since the last call and removes them from the reply.
New bytes can be taken with readAll().
Validates and stores state, and moves the last time seen forward to now.
True when version, platform and architecture have the forms that the contract allows.
True for a valid time in UTC whose wire timestamp is valid.
